## Hypothesis

The strategy captures edge through tight premium-based stops (35%) and short time stops (12min) combined with volume confirmation (vol_ratio_threshold>=1.2) and chandelier profit-lock arming at 60%. The edge exists in mean-reversion scalping during intraday pullbacks where volume spikes indicate institutional participation, allowing quick profits before reversals.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on EMA ribbon rejection signals (same as BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup). Exits occur at: 
- TP1: +75% premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75) 
- SL: -35% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) 
- Time stop: 12 minutes (time_stop_min=12) 
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +60% premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) trailing 15% off HWM 
- Strike selection: OTM-2 puts (strike_offset=2) 
- Volume filter: requires current 30-bar volume >= 1.2x 20-bar average volume (vol_ratio_threshold=1.2)
